scope: Correct the Retrolink/DragonRise 0079:0011 SNES-style controller D-pad mapping in the shared bounded HID profile

fixture.h2: operator-attested Sabrent powered hub with external VBUS

controller.description: generic SNES-style USB controller / Retrolink-compatible mapping

mapping.prior_error: the exact profile treated the low nibble at report bit 40 as an eight-way hat; the physical controller keeps that nibble at its neutral value
mapping.canonical_output: GAMEPAD_CAP_DPAD with independent horizontal and vertical bits and a centered middle-third dead zone
mapping.identity_gate: VID, PID, descriptor SHA-256, and parsed-layout shape must all match

artifact.write_policy: primary application only; bootloader, partition table, OTA data, NVS, microSD, and factory backup preserved

focused_tests: exact profile fixtures passed neutral, right, up-left, and down-right decoding
Waveshare controller-first ESP-IDF image built and scripts/verify-console-os-waveshare.py passed

limitations: No changed D-pad packet arrived while the filtered diagnostic monitor was open, so physical Up/Right/Down/Left acceptance still requires the operator to press the controls in Console OS or Input Test.
Button-label placement on generic 0079:0011 clones may vary even when the descriptor matches; this change intentionally affects only D-pad decoding.
Simultaneous two-controller gameplay remains a separate API and hardware acceptance step.
